excerpt: Snyk is a developer security platform that scans code, dependencies, containers and AI-generated code. Plans from free to $25 a month, credits for enterprise, and alternatives.
content:
Snyk is a security company that builds tools for developers. Its platform finds and helps fix vulnerabilities in the code a team writes, in the open-source packages it depends on, in container images and in infrastructure-as-code files, and it now presents itself as an AI Security Platform: an independent layer that checks AI-generated code, governs AI coding agents and secures applications that use AI. It plugs into developers' editors, command line, source-code hosting, CI/CD pipelines and AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

Snyk was founded in 2015 and reached unicorn status in 2020, according to its About page. It is headquartered in Boston and lists offices in Bucharest, Cluj, Lisbon, London, Ottawa, San Francisco, Singapore, Sydney, Tel Aviv, Tokyo and Zürich. Customers named on its site include Google, Atlassian, Spotify, Snowflake, Twilio, Kroger, Manulife and Jaguar Land Rover.

What it scans

The plans page lists the products by what they check. Snyk Code is static analysis (SAST) of your own source code. Snyk Open Source is software composition analysis (SCA) of the packages you install. Container scans images, IaC scans infrastructure-as-code configuration, and Secrets looks for leaked keys. API & Web tests running applications. A newer family called Evo covers AI security posture, coding-agent security and AI-driven penetration testing; Snyk says Evo is not available on the Free or Team plans.

Pricing

The Free plan costs nothing and covers SCA, SAST, IaC and Container scanning with editor, CLI and repository integrations, limited to 5 projects and 100 Snyk Code tests a month. Team starts at $25 a month, billed monthly at a flat rate for development teams of up to 10 developers, and raises the limits to 100 projects and 1,000 Code tests a month, with a Jira integration and next-business-day support. Enterprise is sold as a platform subscription with prepaid credits, where one credit equals one dollar. Each product burns credits at a published rate; Code and Open Source, for example, cost one credit per active contributor per day.

We have not tested Snyk ourselves. This page brings together Snyk's official site, its own announcements and reputable news coverage, plus the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web app, IDE plugins, CLI and CI/CD integrations
profile.summary_short: Developer security platform for code, dependencies, containers, IaC and AI-generated code

use_cases: Find vulnerable open-source packages in a project and get upgrade fixes
Scan your own code for security flaws while you write it in the IDE
Check container images and infrastructure-as-code files before deploying
Review code produced by AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor

fit: are a development team that wants security checks inside the editor, CLI and pull requests
have up to 10 developers and want a flat monthly price (Team)
use AI coding assistants and want their output checked
not_fit: need the Evo AI-security products on a small budget: they are Enterprise-only
have a large codebase on the Free plan: it stops at 5 projects and 100 Code tests a month
want a fixed price at enterprise scale: Enterprise usage is metered in credits

pros: Usable free plan covering four scan types
Integrates with IDEs, CLI, repositories, CI/CD and AI coding assistants
Published credit rate card for Enterprise
cons: Free plan limits are tight for more than a few projects
Team is aimed at teams of up to 10 developers

pricing.intro: Snyk's own plans, in US dollars.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: SCA, SAST, IaC and Container scanning; IDE, CLI and repository integrations; 5 projects; 100 Snyk Code tests a month

plans.name: Team
plans.detail: Flat monthly rate for teams of up to 10 developers; 100 projects; 1,000 Code tests a month; Jira integration; next-business-day support

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Platform subscription with prepaid credits (1 credit = $1) usable across Snyk products, including Evo

notes: Enterprise credit rates per day: Code and Open Source 1.0 per active contributor; IaC 0.33; Secrets 0.66; Container 0.33 per monitored image; API & Web 3.0 per provisioned target.
Evo AI pentesting costs 4,000 credits per assessment. Evo is not available on Free or Team.

alternatives.intro: Other application-security platforms. Descriptions come from each product's own site; check their pricing pages for current rates.

items.name: Semgrep
items.what: Application security platform with AI-assisted SAST, SCA and secrets detection
items.difference: Built around an extensible rules engine developers can write their own checks for.

items.name: GitHub Advanced Security
items.what: Built-in, AI-powered security for GitHub repositories and the software supply chain
items.difference: Lives inside GitHub, so it suits teams already hosting code there.

items.name: Checkmarx
items.what: Agentic application security testing platform with hybrid scanning and AI agents
items.difference: An enterprise AppSec suite, typically bought through sales.

faq.a: It scans your code, open-source dependencies, container images, infrastructure-as-code and AI-generated code for security problems, and suggests fixes inside the tools developers already use.
Yes, there is a free plan with SCA, SAST, IaC and Container scanning, limited to 5 projects and 100 Snyk Code tests a month.
Team starts at $25 a month for up to 10 developers. Enterprise uses prepaid credits at $1 each, spent at a published daily rate per product.
Boston, with offices in eleven other cities including London, Tel Aviv, Singapore and Tokyo. It was founded in 2015.

faq.q: Does Snyk work with AI coding assistants?
faq.a: Snyk says it integrates with assistants including Claude Code, Cursor and Codex and validates AI-generated code.
